## Added
- **Rebindable vein-mine activation key** — a new *Vein-mine (hold)* keybind (unbound by default; set it in Controls). Hold it while breaking a block to vein-mine. A new **Sneak activates** option (on by default) keeps the classic hold-Sneak trigger, or turn it off to require your own key so you can crouch without vein-mining.
- **Toggle vein-mining keybind** — a new *Toggle vein-mining* keybind (unbound by default) flips vein-mining on and off on the fly, with a chat message only you can see. Resets to on each time the game launches.
